title: Cathedral Experiment 3: HEAVEN//MASS
description: V2 backing, bars 1-12 (bell, hats, then kick, snare, 808, clank), with HEAVEN//MASS: an original four-part passage.

tracks.description: IRON PULSE at C2 (body, gated 1/8) + skin slap C3 (knock) + log rim C5 (click), one hit = three layers.
TITANIUM CRACK -2 st + HEADLINER context snare + skin slap F3, gated short; TITANIUM ghosts.
V12 GHOST TICK and OPEN CIRCUIT: the backbeat left alone, triplets under the hook, two announcing rolls.
V12 CHROME STRIKE at F4 + F3: the bell that marks bars 1, 5, 13 and the end.
The same bell gated short on C5/F5: a sparse steel off-beat figure.
Living Bass played as a tuned sliding 808 (rack stem), ducked under every kick.
HEAVEN//MASS basses (octavists in bar 12), with their Nave; a 4 dB duck on each kick.
HEAVEN//MASS tenors; a 2 dB duck on each kick.
